template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If the Odoo login page appears, sign in with username {{v2}} and password {{v3}} - type that password text exactly as given, character for character, into the password field. Do not wait for network idle (the app long-polls and is never idle); wait for concrete page state instead. Report which page you land on after login and which user is shown as logged in.

provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ in the browser. If the Odoo login page appears, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} - type that password text exactly as given, character for character, into the password field. Do not wait for network idle (the app long-polls and is never idle); wait for concrete page state instead. Report which page you land on after login and which user is shown as logged in.
